structured.feedback: The description is about 230 words in Markdown, under the 300 limit, with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out the breathability, fit and protection complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the "holds its shape wash after wash" claim (reviews mention fraying), and the light use of the reviews.
